data.standardized_narrative: During 2018 the syndicate recognised material adverse prior-year development. On a gross basis cumulative claims estimates for underwriting years up to and including 2016 moved adversely by approximately $80.1m (c.21% of opening gross claims outstanding of $377.3m), driven principally by Non-Marine Liability (largest contributor) and Property Direct & Facultative deterioration, including late large loss emergence and strengthened IBNR. Reinsurance recoverables offset part of this movement such that the reported net deterioration was $48.466m. A number of named catastrophe events (2017 hurricanes and 2016/2017 earthquakes and wildfires) and large individual losses contributed to the reserve strengthening.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2017). Prior-year gross reserve movement was calculated from the published GROSS claims development triangle (current diagonals vs previous diagonals for UW years <=2016) because the explicit movement note in the Technical Provisions reported the NET deterioration ($48.466m). The gross movement derived from the triangle is approx $80.1m (strengthening); net movement reported in notes is $48.466m, implying reinsurer recoveries of c.$31.6m on the prior-year deterioration. All amounts are in the syndicate's reporting currency (USD). Some event-level impacts are not individually quantified in the report; where the report gives only aggregated amounts (e.g. total net cost of five 2018 events $21.7m) individual event losses are left null.
